description:
Rush your profiles for consideration

No. of positions: 10
UI developer,
Cupertino CA
CONTACT -   Full time / CTH
Client : Apple 
Need locals to CA for F2F Interview. Only GC/USC 

 Skill-  very good experience on Angular JS.  And   frontend backend skill. 


Responsibilities: 
•    Work with User Experience and Engineering teams to define, maintain, implement, and enforce style guides, standards, reusable templates, and best practices for client-side development. 
•    Assist development teams with client-side development and periodic performance web-site optimizations. 
Requirements 
•    6+ years of experience in UI design and software development in a commercial setting.
•    6+ years of experience in client-side web technologies including JavaScript, AJAX, JQuery, HTML, HTML5, CSS, CSS3 and XML. Exposure to Web Services (RESTFUL and SOAP) and MVC Architecture. 
•    Experience with JavaScript frameworks, e.g. Can.Js, Angular.Js, Backbone, d3.
•    Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.
•    Strong communication skills and ability to work closely with others.


  



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
